title.narrative: INVENTORYING AND SAFEGUARDING OF INTANGIBLE CULTURAL HERITAGE IN TAFILA GOVERNORATE

description.narrative: This project aims to inventory the intangible cultural heritage in Tafila Governorate by involving the local community, and association in the inventory process, then providing the Heritage Directorate with elements of intangible cultural heritage to include in the database and identify elements that are threatened with extinction, and raising awareness of the importance of intangible cultural heritage in the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan, and linking it to sustainable development processes, according to the inventory form certified by the Heritage Directorate in various inventory projects. The form is filled out by the local community according to the domains of the 2003 UNESCO Heritage Convention.
